name: storyboard-builder
description: Turns the winning sketches into a fifteen-panel storyboard with a real opening scene and stress-tests it for the gaps a tester will fall into, part of the Design Sprint Pack by 90n. Use this whenever the user says "run storyboard-builder", "build the storyboard", "what screens do we need", "write the opening scene", "turn the winning sketch into a flow", or when the supervote is done and the build crew needs a spec. Use it even for a vague ask like "what exactly are we prototyping".
